name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: Connection Escrow: Holding AI-Agent Pod Egress in the Kernel Until an Isolated Verifier Rules
items.dek: Connection escrow eBPF program holds outbound TCP from supervised pods at kernel connect() until separate verifier signs verdict.
items.unproven: tested on adversarial suite in lab environment; does not measure performance overhead in production workloads or interaction with real agent frameworks; verifier latency impact unclear

items.title: Fake News, Real Crashes: Information Injection Attacks on LLM Financial Trading Agents
items.dek: LLM trading agents fail on information injection (62% attack success) far worse than prompt injection (14%), with surface-form cues mattering more than content.
items.unproven: tested only on 15 U.S. stocks and five injection vectors; generalization to other asset classes and agent architectures not established.

items.title: SEAL: Towards Persistent Tool Poisoning Attack against LLM Agents via Prefix-Eliciting Trigger
items.dek: SEAL achieves persistent tool-poisoning attacks on LLM agents across multi-round interactions using prefix-eliciting triggers.
items.unproven: whether defense mechanisms can reliably detect or mitigate the attack; tested on limited agent types

items.title: RAGLeak: Supply-Chain Privacy Backdoors in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.dek: Supply-chain backdoor attack on RAG systems uses reversible obfuscation to leak private documents at 100% success rate across defenses.
items.unproven: Whether the attack succeeds against systems not in the three tested model families or domains; backdoor persistence under full retraining with sanitized data remains untested.

items.title: PQC Migration of IPsec: Reliable Composite Key Sharing Mechanisms in IKEv2
items.dek: Composite key-sharing handshake for post-quantum IKEv2 migration uses TCP concatenation to avoid IP fragmentation failures.
items.unproven: Whether composite approach integrates cleanly with existing IKEv2 implementations and RFC compliance; tested in controlled network conditions only.

items.title: How Effectively Do Security Skills Guide Coding Agents in Vulnerability Detection in Linux Kernel?
items.dek: LLM agents locate correct vulnerability functions in 24% of attempts on Linux kernel bugs; failure modes suggest reasoning and evidence-acquisition gaps.
items.unproven: whether SKILL-SIF self-improvement generalizes beyond Claude Code or kernel code; single model family and domain

items.title: Spectrum of Liability: Forensically Sound Acquisition of Wireless Evidence for the Reconstruction of Maritime Cyber-Physical Incidents
items.dek: Forensic acquisition methodology preserves wireless IQ and receiver state for maritime incident reconstruction resistant to tampering.
items.unproven: whether courts accept this evidence; limited deployment context in actual maritime investigations

items.title: Accountable partial understanding: securing the epistemic attack surface of agentic systems
items.dek: Taxonomy of four epistemic attack categories on agentic systems, defining accountable partial understanding with six necessary conditions.
items.unproven: does not demonstrate that the six conditions are jointly sufficient or that they hold under real agent deployment; does not test the taxonomy against incident data

items.title: BrushOff: Stroke-Based Re-rendering as a Watermark Removal Attack on Painting
items.dek: BrushOff stroke-based repainting removes VINE watermark detection from 97.8% to 1.8% without training or generative models.
items.unproven: limited to painting domain; does not establish whether this generalizes to other media or watermarking schemes; no user-facing watermark product tested

items.title: Fortress: Fork Resistant Transparency logs Relying on Social graph Structure
items.dek: Fortress protocol replaces external bulletin boards in transparency systems with social-graph-based fork detection, eliminating dependency on trusted infrastructure.
items.unproven: protocol described theoretically; no implementation, no deployment data, no comparison against practical bulletin-board systems at scale.

items.title: LeakBench: Auditing Reward Hacking through Prediction-Time Leakage in Clinical Modeling Agents
items.dek: LeakBench audit suite catches clinical agents leaking prediction-time features; LLM agents (DeepSeek, GPT-6-astra) leak in 10/10 unconstrained runs, zero with explicit constraints.
items.unproven: agents and datasets are future-dated (September 2026) and appear synthetic or simulated; real-world adoption of constraint-based controls in medical LLM workflows not established.

items.title: SPLASH: Contrastive Audit Pressure for Detecting and Localizing Security Hallucinations in Generated Code
items.dek: SPLASH detects and locates security hallucinations in LLM-generated code using audit pressure (contrast between security and style review log-probabilities), selecting secure code in 74% of cases.
items.unproven: evaluated on 899 tasks across 12 models; generalization to production codebases and integration into developer workflow not demonstrated.

items.title: Secure Agentic Coding through Counterexample-Grounded Feedback
items.dek: Counterexample-grounded feedback loop improves secure code generation by grounding security signals in program execution traces.
items.unproven: Whether gains hold on production codebases and deployment patterns outside the benchmark; tested on held-out splits of controlled datasets only.

items.title: Towards Architectural-Level Safety Control: Relocating Hazardous Knowledge into Removable Experts in Mixture-of-Experts Models
items.dek: Architectural-level knowledge relocation in mixture-of-experts concentrates hazardous knowledge in removable experts via selective routing.
items.unproven: Whether relocated knowledge is irretrievable after expert removal; tested on specific hazard categories and model families, not demonstrated at scale.

items.title: Go will reject certificate chains containing eight distrusted SPKIs
items.dek: Go runtime will reject eight specific compromised certificate authorities, requiring review of internal PKI and service certificates.
items.unproven: whether the eight SPKIs cover all relevant internal CAs in financial services deployments; timing of Go version rollout across the reader's estate.

items.title: Proof-of-Machine-Learning-Inference: Mining Knowledge, Not Hashes
items.dek: Proof-of-ML-Inference replaces hash work with user-requested ML inference in blockchain consensus, reducing wasted computation.
items.unproven: simulation only; does not establish that LLMs and diffusion models satisfy the stated computational assumptions under attack; no live network deployment

items.title: DM-RSA-OAEP: Formal Treatment of a Dual-Modulus Fault-Detection Countermeasure Based on Physical Diversity
items.dek: Formal IND-CCA2 proof and fault-detection theorem for DM-RSA-OAEP under explicit physical-diversity assumption.
items.unproven: proof depends on physical-diversity assumption that fails under common-mode faults; does not address implementation side channels; no concrete performance comparison to standard RSA-OAEP

items.title: Beyond Attack Success Rate: Cost-Aware Metric for Evaluating Iterative LLM Jailbreaks
items.dek: ASR_STEP metric penalizes repeated victim-model calls in jailbreak evaluation; GCG scores drop 7.0–8.7 percentage points, PAIR 3.4–12.
items.unproven: metric design choices not validated against deployed defenses; does not measure real detection probability or intervention latency; limited to three model families

items.title: Plex vulnerabilities being exploited in the wild to drop a cryptominer
items.dek: Plex vulnerabilities are exploited in active cryptominer campaigns; patch status and affected versions not specified in submission.
items.unproven: whether Plex runs in the reader's environment or supply chain; no PoC or specific CVE details provided

items.title: Signature Knowledge Shielding: Protecting Antivirus Detection Knowledge through Robust Embedding Matching
items.dek: Signature Knowledge Shielding protects antivirus rules by adding decoy signatures that make detection logic harder to reverse-engineer through black-box probing.
items.unproven: evaluated against unspecified query budgets and attack methods; robustness against adversaries with access to detector internals not addressed.

items.title: PhantomTac: Hijacking Robotic Tactile Systems with Deploy-and-forget Tags
items.dek: PhantomTac spoofs magnetic tactile sensors in robotic hands via thin battery-free tags, causing object crushing or dropping during manipulation.
items.unproven: proof-of-concept on lab robotic systems; exploitation in production industrial or collaborative robots not demonstrated.

items.title: SpanGuard: Decoupling Instruction Localization from Authorization for Lightweight IPI Defense
items.dek: SpanGuard detects indirect prompt injection in small LLMs by decoupling instruction localization (unsupervised segmentation) from authorization (small-model judgment).
items.unproven: evaluated on tool-output segmentation in an unspecified threat model; no data on robustness to adaptive attacks or comparison to full-model guardrails in production.

items.title: NIOCIS: Typed-Decision Next-Hop Routing with Node-Conditioned Option Spaces for Tool-Use Agents
items.dek: Small model replaces expensive LLM hops in agent routing at 32% accuracy and 10ms latency, matching logged production decisions.
items.unproven: Whether the 32% accuracy translates to acceptable agent outcomes in production; tested only on logged retrospective decisions, not live deployment.

items.title: RuneScape Bench: MMOs for Agents [video]
items.dek: MMO environment as benchmark for agent behavior; vocabulary contribution, not a SDLC decision driver.
items.unproven: whether RuneScape Bench predicts agent failure modes in production or correlates with security-relevant outcomes

items.title: Mercury 3: Diffusion at scale
items.dek: Mercury 3 diffusion model from commercial vendor; marketing for a product.
items.unproven: whether claims hold outside vendor benchmarks or differ meaningfully from prior releases

noise.title: OpenCode Hacked: User credentials leaked
noise.dek: Credential breach at OpenCode reported via social media; no technical detail, scope, or remediation path given.
noise.unproven: identity of affected users, nature of credentials, whether the reader's org uses OpenCode, timeline, or mitigation steps

noise.title: William Gibson and the trademarking of cyberspace
noise.dek: Historical piece on William Gibson's cyberspace trademark and cultural impact.

noise.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science
noise.dek: CERN and Mistral announced a partnership to apply AI to scientific research.
noise.unproven: entirely outside application security and SDLC tooling domain
